items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: If I need a trio, I guess one of the first drummers I would call would be Winard Harper. He’s on this recording also.

ctx.x: If I need a trio, I guess one of the first drummers I would call would be Winard Harper. He’s on this recording also. I was lucky enough to get two of my first choices. I was very happy, happy with the way that the recording turned out, and I also use them, I get them — for the Sweet Basil engagement, I call them well in advance to be sure that I can get them or somebody like them.
And a job like that, if you have a week or something at Sweet Basil’s, are you able to rehearse with those fellas, or do you just work enough together that you can pretty much go in and—
